mode.title: Mode
mode.description: datasetRun judges one Langfuse dataset run (requires datasetRunId). online samples finished production apify-ai traces from a time window; the sampleRate, maxItems, environment, windowStart and windowEnd inputs apply only here.

datasetRunId.title: Langfuse dataset-run id
datasetRunId.description: The run to judge; the Runner Actor returns this in its OUTPUT as datasetRunId. Required in datasetRun mode, ignored in online mode.

sampleRate.title: Sample rate (online)
sampleRate.description: Fraction of completed traces in the window to judge, 0 to 1. The sample size is ceil(sampleRate * completedTraces), then capped by maxItems.

maxItems.title: Max sampled traces (online)
maxItems.description: Ceiling on the sampled traces per run; the shuffle happens before the cap so a capped sample stays unbiased. Bounds judge cost and run time on busy days.

windowStart.title: Window start override (online)
windowStart.description: ISO 8601. Replaces the checkpoint (or now-24h) lower bound. Setting either override skips the checkpoint entirely: it is neither read nor written, so backfills and debugging never move production.

windowEnd.title: Window end override (online)
windowEnd.description: ISO 8601, exclusive. Replaces the computed upper bound (now minus the agent request timeout minus export lag). Same checkpoint rule as windowStart.

environment.title: Langfuse environment (online)
environment.description: Only traces from this Langfuse environment are selected. The same service emits the same span names from dev, staging and prod into one project, so without this they would be scored as one population. apify-ai-agent sets it from its own environment setting: prod, staging or dev. Use "staging" to backfill staging traffic. An enum, because an unknown value returns zero rows without an error and would silently advance the checkpoint.

judgeModel.title: Judge model (OpenRouter id)
judgeModel.description: Exact model id, never an alias; stamped into every score. Defaults per mode: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6 in datasetRun mode, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash in online mode.

promptLabel.title: Judge prompt label
promptLabel.description: Langfuse prompt-management label; resolved to a concrete version once per batch.

force.title: Force re-judge
force.description: Write a new score set even when a matching (rubric, model, prompt, impl) set exists. Never mutates old scores.

langfuseBaseUrl.title: Langfuse base URL
langfuseBaseUrl.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL env var.

langfusePublicKey.title: Langfuse public key
langfusePublicKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY env var.

langfuseSecretKey.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuseSecretKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY env var.

artifactStore.title: Eval artifacts store
artifactStore.description: The named key-value store the Runner wrote full logs and tool-schema snapshots to. Grants this limited-permission Actor read access to verify snapshots.
